description: This file defines the 'Column' class in the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet namespace, representing a spreadsheet column with methods to get cell and row iterators, check if the column is empty, and retrieve the column index or parent worksheet.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a worksheet column, providing access to cell and row iterators, and methods to determine if the column is empty.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Column object with the parent worksheet and the column index (e.g., 'A').

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destroys the object and clears the worksheet reference.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column's index as a string (e.g., 'A').

methods.name: getCellIterator
methods.description: Returns a cell iterator for the specified row range within the column.

methods.name: getRowIterator
methods.description: Same as getCellIterator, provides an alias for iterating over rows in the column.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the column contains no non-empty cells based on specified flags and row range.
